evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ; modifies `src/rpc/net.cpp`, `src/bitcoin-cli.cpp`, and functional RPC tests to expose `cpu_load`.
rationale: The PR exposes message-processing CPU usage per peer in `getpeerinfo` and `bitcoin-cli -netinfo` so operators can identify resource-intensive connections. This adds useful diagnostic visibility and exploratory data for peer prioritization, though it represents a non-urgent diagnostic metric.
